title: maint.event.v1{kind=quarantine_erase}
description: Phase 7 §7.1 / Phase 8 §8.3 — right-to-erasure (DSAR / GDPR). `target` is the client_id whose quarantine_samples rows must be tombstoned. Storage agent is the SOLE consumer; on consume it sets raw_bytes=tombstone(0x00) + erased_at=now() and emits a sibling kind=pii_erased audit event (NOT in this schema — that's a separate kind sub-schema).

target.description: client_id whose rows are to be erased.

client_id.description: OPERATOR's <user>@<host> — NOT to be confused with `target` (the data-subject's id).

reason.description: Operator-recorded justification (DSAR ticket id, regulator request, etc.).
